title: Stress IQ test during Air Force recruitment screening

tellings.quote: And so you take the same test, but I put on this oxygen mask that sealed my face with no air coming to it.

plain: In 1994, near UCLA in California, a man named Jake Barber, who says he later flew a helicopter to retrieve a UFO, says he went through a stress test during Air Force recruitment screening. He tells Michels he took an IQ test once normally and then again while wearing 'an oxygen mask that sealed my face with no air coming to it,' to see how he thought under strain.
